items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I said, Ed don't know Lula White if he's here.

ctx.x: Huh? Did you work there? No, nothing but piano. Yeah, I already telling people about he was there. He know much about Lula White as you do. I'm not telling you no story. He was out there in the country, pig and peas. I heard that woman come talking about, Ed used to go with her. I said, go with who? I said, Ed don't know Lula White if he's here. He used to go with her. George Lambert was old man, a big gambler. I had the gambling house on Cronlet, on St. Charles, between Petita and the foot of Petita, between…
Who was the piano player at the Lula White? Who played there? Well, there were several different fellas.
